caption: The drawing is composed of multiple outlined shapes arranged across an off-white or light beige background, all drawn with fine, light gray pencil lines. Each shape appears to be a garment pattern piece, with a variety of forms including curved, straight, and angled lines. At the top left are three larger pieces, one with rounded edges and a sequence of short perpendicular lines along the left edge, another with a bulbous end and a narrow extension, and a third with an angular, straight-lined silhouette. Near the top right are two elongated, irregular shapes with notched lines near the middle, and a small triangular piece nearby. Below, other objects include rectangular and trapezoidal forms, one of which has three circles inside and a short line of zigzag marks, and another that consists of nested rectangles with dashed lines. Adjacent are several small pieces, rectangular and square in shape, some containing rows of small circles, lines, or vertical slits. Each piece is marked with letters, numbers, and small notations, and some have small circular holes indicated. There are faint pencil notations and arrows, particularly in the lower left corner, where "line 1" and "finished line" are lightly written. The overall arrangement is orderly, with space left between the pattern pieces and no background shading or color beyond the paper.
title: Suit Pattern
